title: Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2 is engineered for high-velocity circuit stability. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1302g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~90 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Track-focused carbon with aerodynamic spoiler and emergency release system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track fit; may feel tight on larger head sizes without sizing up.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Track / Race lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2 brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2 represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Raptor TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
